identification.description: A fragrant oleo-gum-resin obtained from Commiphora wightii, occurring as yellowish-brown to brown resinous masses.

shlokas:
गुग्गुलुर्विशदस्तिक्तो वीर्योष्णः पित्तलः सरः ।
कषायः कटुकः पाके कटू रूक्षो लघुः परः ॥३५॥
भग्नसन्धानकृद्वृष्यः सूक्ष्मः स्वर्यो रसायनः ।
दीपनः पिच्छिलो बल्यः कफवातव्रणापचीः ॥३६॥
मेदोमेहाश्मवातांश्च क्लेदकुष्ठाममारुतान् ।
पिडकाग्रन्थिशोफार्शोगण्डमालाकृमीञ्जयेत् ॥३७॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Karpuradi Varga, verses 35–37 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 33–35 citation and wording were corrected

identity.name: Ashoka
identity.botanical_name: Saraca asoca (Roxb.) Willd. (syn. Saraca indica L.)

identification.description: Evergreen tree with dense foliage, paripinnate leaves and clusters of orange to red flowers; the medicinal bark is grey-brown externally and reddish internally.

shlokas:
अशोकः शीतलस्तिक्तो ग्राही वर्ण्यः कषायकः ।
दोषापचीतृषादाहकृमिशोषविषास्रजित् ॥४८॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Pushpa Varga, verse 48; edition numbering may vary.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 47–48 citation was retained with the searchable recension's verse 48

identification.description: Erect herb or undershrub with cordate velvety leaves and small yellow flowers.

shlokas:
बला वाट्यालिका वाट्या सैव वाट्यालकाऽपि च ।
महाबला पीतपुष्पा सहदेवी च सा स्मृता ॥१२३॥
ततोऽन्यातिबला ऋष्यप्रोक्ता कङ्कतिका च सा ।
गाङ्गेरुकी नागबला झषा ह्रस्वगवेधुका ॥१२४॥
बलाचतुष्टयं शीतं मधुरं बलकान्तिकृत् ।
स्निग्धं ग्राहि समीरास्रपित्तास्रक्षतनाशनम् ॥१२५॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 123–127 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 142–143 citation and wording were corrected

identification.description: Perennial spreading herb with stout root, opposite unequal leaves and small pink to reddish flowers in branched clusters.

shlokas:
पुनर्नवा श्वेतमूला शोथघ्नी दीर्घपत्रिका ।
कटु कषायानुरसा पाण्डुघ्नी दीपनी परा ।
शोफानिलगरश्लेष्महरी व्रण्योदरप्रणुत् ॥१९८॥
पुनर्नवापरा रक्ता रक्तपुष्पा शिलाटिका ।
शोथघ्नः क्षुद्रवर्षाभूर्वृषकेतुः कपिल्लकः ॥१९९॥
पुनर्नवारुणा तिक्ता कटुपाका हिमा लघुः ।
वातला ग्राहिणी श्लेष्मपित्तरक्तविनाशिनी ॥२००॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 198–200 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 231–233 citation and wording were corrected

identification.description: Fast-growing shrub with large palmately lobed leaves, terminal inflorescences and prickly three-lobed capsules containing mottled seeds.

shlokas:
शुक्ल एरण्ड आमण्डश्चित्रो गन्धर्वहस्तकः ।
पञ्चाङ्गुलो वर्धमानो दीर्घदण्डोऽप्यदण्डकः ।
वातारिस्तरुणश्चापि रुबूकश्च निगद्यते ॥५२॥
रक्तोऽपरो रुबूकः स्यादुरुबूको रुबुस्तथा ।
व्याघ्रपुच्छश्च वातारिश्चञ्चुरुत्तानपत्रकः ॥५३॥
एरण्डयुग्मं मधुरमुष्णं गुरु विनाशयेत् ।
शूलशोथकटीबस्तिशिरःपीडोदरज्वरान् ॥५४॥
ब्रध्नश्वासकफानाहकासकुष्ठाममारुतान् ॥५५॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 52–58 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 60–62 citation and wording were corrected
